== Standard templates ==
All articles in version-specific [[help:namespace|namespace]]s (as well as Masterwork and Utility articles) should begin with {{tl|quality|''rating''}}, followed by {{tl|av}}.   

== Link templates ==
* <code>{{tl|bug|''issue ID''}}</code>, for linking to bugs on the [http://www.bay12games.com/dwarves/mantisbt/my_view_page.php bug tracker]
** <code>{{tl|bug|''issue ID''|link{{=}}1}}</code>

See also: [[:Category:Inline formatting templates]]

== Citation templates ==
{{tl|cite}} is the "main" citation template, although there are other, more specialized templates as well - see [[:Category:Citation templates]] for a complete list.
